Declared HS 690721 matches the dominant observed code; one record shows 69072200 and non-tile items (catalogues 49111020, sanitaryware 69101000) — no HS correction needed for the core product. Note the name in the request ("M/S VARMORA GRANITO (P) LTD") maps to two customs entities at the same Dhuva/Wankaner address: VARMORA GRANITO PRIVATE LIMITED and VARMORA GRANITO LIMITED (claimed legal name) — both show export records, so the legal-entity ambiguity does not affect the shipment verdict. Domestic (India) supply evidence is missing only because search and the company site were unreachable, not because absence was proven; revenue/export volume figures are not public in the free views and are left null. No rejection grounds: entity exists and is actively shipping.
